question: What assembly devoted to Vedic study should be remembered on the right side?
premises: The visualization assigns groups to specific directions.
An assembly of sages devoted to Vedic study is present there.
inference: On the right side, the meditator should remember an assembly of sages devoted to Vedic study.
plain_english: Likewise, on the right side, one should remember the assembly of sages devoted to the study of the Vedas.
